feeds.title: Outdoor Canada » Hunting
feeds.description: Outdoor Canada encourages anglers and hunters to improve their skills and broaden their knowledge of the outdoors. Included are fishing and hunting hot spots and roundups of the best new gear. It is Canada's only national magazine for anglers and hunters. The exclusive source for all things fishing, hunting and conservation since 1972.

feeds.title: Happiest Outdoors
feeds.description: A hiking and outdoors blog by Taryn Eyton. My home is in Vancouver but my heart is in the mountains. I share advice, info, and inspiration about my happy place: the Great Outdoors.

feeds.title: Traversing
feeds.description: Traversing offers Canadian camping and canoeing news, tips, and gear reviews. We publish daily blog posts and always welcome your feedback. We love to share what Canada has to offer!

feeds.title: Outdoors & On the Go Blog
feeds.description: Outdoors & On the Go is a Newfoundland Outdoor Adventure Blog by Katie B. She is a local tour guide, specializing in hiking and trekking, author of 'Hikes of Western Newfoundland' and gear reviewer for Get Out There magazine.

feeds.title: Fish'n Canada
feeds.description: Canada's source for everything related to fishing and the outdoors! If you're looking to learn about fishing this is the place for you.

feeds.title: Play Outside Guide
feeds.description: Play outside guide is everything families need to know to get outside and have fun, outdoor families, backpacking, travel reviews, product reviews, gear reviews, biking with kids, hiking with kids, calgary, canadian rockies, road trips, alberta hiking, alberta camping, bc hiking, bc camping, outdoor fun.

feeds.title: The Outdoors Guy Blog
feeds.description: The Outdoors Guy, Jeff, enjoys traveling and has visited every Canadian province over the years. Jeff Morrison was introduced to the hunting, fishing, and trapping by his Dad at a very young age; falling in love instantly. Over the years he made the Great Outdoors a focal point for his life's work. Jeff maintains his Outdoors Guy Blog and contributes regularly to Northern/Northeastern Ontario Tourism Site.

feeds.title: PerfectDayToPlay » Outdoor Activities
feeds.description: PerfectDayToPlay is a Eco-Smart Family Travel and Outdoors blog. Read about outdoor activities like things to do outdoors, hiking & camping with kids, learning through play, kids activities, sports & gear and more.

feeds.title: Family Adventures In The Canadian Rockies
feeds.description: This blog seeks to chronicle the joys and challenges of taking kids hiking, camping, backpacking, skiing, biking, paddling and all-out exploring in the Canadian Rockies.

feeds.title: Subarctic Angling Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is to provide northern anglers with the information, advice, and media that will inspire Canadians to get outside and enjoy our beautiful landscape while respecting and conserving all that it has to offer.

feeds.title: Voyageur Tripper
feeds.description: Voyageur Tripper is a blog dedicated to outdoor adventure for those of us who aren't professional explorers. Through informative resources and how-to guides, my aim is for Voyageur Tripper to enable people (you!) to get outside more and take increasingly challenging trips. I want Voyageur Tripper to be the place you go for knowledge on camping, hiking, paddling - anything outside and active.

feeds.title: All of Algonquin Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to my travels through Algonquin Park. My goal is to paddle every canoe route accessible lake in the Park and I'm about halfway there. The site has trip reports, campsite reviews and other Algonquin related material.
